Name: Naharai the Berothite
Summary: Armourbearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:39: Armourbearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: The mention of Naharai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
